integrity: Five-step self-contained algebraic/combinatorial argument and standalone exhaustive finite cases support correctness; historical coverage remains a residual risk. Independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite graphs with two parts of size at least two; counts are labeled, and do not classify arbitrary bipartite graphs or Krohn-Rhodes complexity. Previously known star-graph instances are not claimed as new. Exhaustive computer checks are finite only.
title: Rank censuses and a sharp regularity criterion for biclique continuous-map monoids
